responsibilities: At Infinite Lambda, Analytics Engineers turn vast amounts of data into insightful, easy-to-use, automated BI solutions.
This is a highly client-facing role where you will work directly with our partners’ project teams to deliver high-impact analytics and reporting that drive better business decisions.
You will leverage modern data tools with a strong focus on dbt for reliable data modeling/transformation and BI tools for analytics to build scalable, self-service solutions.

evidence.domain_risk: deliver high-impact analytics and reporting that drive better business decisions
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect client business decisions, with no financial reporting or regulatory language.
